dialect.detail: OS/VS COBOL compiler noted in comments; uses EXEC CICS and EXEC SQL (DB2) embedded commands; DFHBMSCA and DFHAID inline (not copied); CICS transaction AXDB; map BADDB2; typical IBM mainframe CICS/DB2 online program structure
evidence: comment: THIS PROGRAM IS WRITTEN FOR THE OS/VS COBOL COMPILER

purpose.domain_detail: Personnel/person record management system; CICS online add-record screen for a PERSONFL DB2 table containing person number, name, address, salary
purpose.summary: CADDDB2 is a CICS online program that handles the Add Record function for a personnel file (PERSONFL) stored in DB2. It sends and receives a BMS map (BADDB2), edits screen input, and inserts a new person record into the DB2 table, handling duplicate record conditions and returning to a main menu on PF3.

notable_features: EXEC SQL (DB2) with DECLARE TABLE and INCLUDE SQLCA
EXEC CICS (BMS map send/receive, HANDLE CONDITION, HANDLE AID, ASKTIME, FORMATTIME, RETURN with COMMAREA)
Inline DFHBMSCA and DFHAID copybook substitutes (commented-out COPY statements)
Commented-out DLI GU call suggesting possible IMS heritage or migration
BMS map BADD400I/BADD400O with attribute bytes (L/F/A/I field pattern)
verdict.notes: Source truncated at 16000 chars; PROCEDURE DIVISION cut off mid-paragraph at 0500-EDIT-SCREEN. Commented-out COPY statements (BADDB2, DFHBMSCA) replaced with inline definitions. Commented-out EXEC DLI suggests possible IMS-to-DB2 migration. One line slightly over 72 chars. Program comment says OS/VS COBOL but structure is consistent with VS COBOL II or COBOL/370 on IBM mainframe.
